# Tiny Chip Studio

> Tiny Chip Studio is a website design and development studio in Tiffin, Ohio, founded by Adam Thomas Janes. We plan, design and build websites for Northwest Ohio businesses (and clients anywhere by phone and video) that say what the business does plainly, earn trust fast, and make contacting them the easy next step. Websites start at $1,200 with a fixed quote before paid work begins.

## Services

- Design & build a website: strategy, custom design and responsive development, from the first content decisions through testing and handoff. WordPress or a custom frontend, chosen for the job. From $1,200, fixed quote.
- Improve an existing website: targeted redesign, clearer content, easier navigation and technical refinement. Fixed quote after a 15-minute call.
- Website review: a scoped review of message, navigation and customer journey with written, prioritized recommendations. Scope and fee agreed before work begins.
- Free website scorecard: fifteen questions, about two minutes, results shown immediately with no email required: https://www.tinychipstudio.com/#scorecard

## How a project works

1. Clarify: understand the business, its customers and the next action a visitor should take.
2. Create: shape the message, the design and the working website.
3. Deliver: test, refine and hand off a dependable result.

A typical website takes about a week of build time once content and approvals are in.
